text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Bakushin O! A great<n>responsibility lies
on our shoulders<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
I fully understand! A number of<n>unauthorized
books have been<n>reportedly spotted in the school
library,<n>and it's up to us class representatives to<n>
investigate!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Выполнитеly on the mark! It's our call to<n>decide
whether those books infringe on<n>academy rules!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now, first up is this book. It's a horrortitled, Evil's Banquet. Oh, there's atagline, "Satanic one-liners to put you inshivers! On sacrificial sale now!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... "Satan is sent to hell for the<n>grave
sin of getting too wild at the bar.<n>Disgruntled at
this unreasonable<n>sentence, he puts a curse on
the land of<n>the living."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There, we meet our tale's protagonist, a<n>man who
has cheated on his wife. But<n>when the truth is
revealed, she hires an<n>assassin for revenge.
Meanwhile, thirteen<n>messengers born from Satan's
curse<n>perform a series of ghastly acts...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Reading this nonsense will do<n>nothing but
rot your brain! I'll let the<n>disciplinary committee
take care of this!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
...No! As class representative, I think this<n>book
should stay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What?! Why?

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
While I don't understand all the details...<n>I sense
something very Bakushin about<n>this book!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
For instance, in the scene where the<n>protagonist
and his wife are trying to<n>escape the zombie
army, their car<n>engine gives out, and they're<n>
unfortunately forced to run three-legged<n>because
a snake is tied around their<n>legs!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
And how single-mindedly steadfast<n>Satan clings
to his sense of humor,<n>cracking joke after joke at
Bakushin<n>speed!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text: It's all so Bakushin! Considering thebook as a whole, I believe it's valuablematerial for conveying Bakushin spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Maybe there's some hidden<n>passion
between the lines of its story,<n>but... I find it too
strange to be left on<n>school grounds.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
Like you say, there may be some<n>problematic
elements in the story!<n>However, I think this book
can act as a<n>teaching aid, warning students not to<n>
play pranks!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
Think of the various takeaways students<n>could
Получите through reading this story...<n>Don't you
think that makes for great<n>education?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, I see. You're always so insightful,<n>Bakushin
O!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! You flatter me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We'll keep this book, for now! The nextone up for consideration is, 666Legends: Reckless Romance at the Endof the World.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Too much eavesdropping and I'll<n>probably give
myself a headache. I<n>better leave while I can...
